title: Resident Credit Hours Counted After a Reduction in Enrollment
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 6 — Credit hours of the resident term after a reduction (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**6.01 Terms.** The *resident term certification* is the latest certification on the benefit whose courses are not all distance learning. The *latest reduction* is the most recent reduction in credits reported on the benefit, taken by its last date of attendance; it carries the credits remaining and the term start and term end of the term it amends. The *credits dropped* are the credits certified on the resident term certification less the credits remaining. The student's *excused credits* are the dropped credits VA treats as dropped on the last date of attendance, never more than the credits dropped. The days of the resident term run from its term start to its term end with both days counted.

**6.02 Rule.** For the rate of pursuit confirmed on a verified month, resident credits after a reduction are counted over the days of the resident term:

(a) **Last date of attendance inside the resident term** (on or after its term start and on or before its term end): the credits remaining plus the student's excused credits count for the days from the term start through the last date of attendance, both counted, and the credits remaining count for the rest of the term; the credits counted are those two products added together and divided by the days of the term. The dropped credits that are not excused therefore count as dropped from the term start.

(b) **Latest reduction belongs to the resident term** (it carries the resident term's term start) **but its last date of attendance is before the term start**: the credits remaining are counted for the whole term.

(c) **Otherwise**: the credits certified on the resident term certification are counted.

**6.03 Worked illustrations (hypothetical term of 100 days, 12 credits certified, 6 credits remaining).**

| Last date of attendance | Excused credits | Credits counted |
|---|---|---|
| Day 40 of the term | 6 | 12 for 40 days and 6 for 60 days: 480 plus 360, divided by 100, is 8.4 |
| Day 40 of the term | 3 | 9 for 40 days and 6 for 60 days: 360 plus 360, divided by 100, is 7.2 |
| Day 40 of the term | 0 | 6 for every day: 6 |
| The day before the term start, same term | any | 6 for the whole term under (b) |
| No reduction on the benefit | — | 12 under (c) |

**6.04 Note.** The credits counted under (a) are not rounded; they are carried as computed.
